changes: Optional bounty suggestions flag repeat open-world attackers: by default, 3 deaths against you or 5 across 3 guild characters in 30 minutes.

Enable suggestions and death sharing separately: Highground: /hg config → Guild bounties. Standalone Bounties: /hgb config → More settings. Standalone Nearby: /hgn config → More settings. Bounties must also be on.
Review reports and bounty drafts: Highground: /hg bounty suggestions. Standalone Bounties: /hgb suggestions. Standalone Nearby: /hgn bounty suggestions. Rewards start blank; saving is your choice.
Notifications wait until combat ends. Dismiss a target for 24 hours or ignore it until you allow it again. Recent reports and dismissals survive reloads and switching bounty addons.
Enemy history and suggestions now skip deaths without a clear player source, including NPCs, environmental deaths and duels. Guild reports are player-supplied evidence, not verified kills.
notice: Restart the game after updating; new files require more than /reload. Keep HighgroundBountyData enabled. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
